gain_offset_note: Measured 2026-08-19 via rl/calibrate_gain.py (real zero-residual x1 on yunpiece.mxl, the training piece), n 182. Written BY HAND: calibrate_gain refused --write because the per-zone medians disagree by 4.65 dB (p +0.52 n=166, f +5.17 n=16), which is more than the 1.5 dB guard allows. This is the tool's own balanced mean-of-zone-medians, and it is also the empirical best for r_dynamic: in-zone over the 182 calibration strokes is 43% at +2.84 against 27% at the global median +0.89, 23% at the p-zone value and 10% at the previous +6.55 (twinkle-derived). UNEXPLAINED: the same measurement on 2026-08-18 gave p +4.88 / f +5.41, spread 0.53 dB. The f zone has barely moved (5.41 -> 5.17) while p fell 4.4 dB. yunpiece's zones split by DURATION (p median 0.111 s, f median 0.500 s), so this is a short-note measurement shift, not a loudness one -- rosin or contact would not be length-selective, and contact is unchanged (2.6-2.7 N both days). Prime suspect is the PR #4 shared audio stream: it is never restarted, so every _start_audio after the first clears the buffer while a 4096-sample (93 ms) block is in flight, putting sample 0 before _audio_t0 and slicing the window ~76 ms early -- two thirds of a 0.111 s note, nothing to a 0.5 s steady-middle window. NOT YET CONFIRMED; the instrumented run to count _start_audio calls was cut short by a robot link drop. Re-measure after that is settled. Zones are absolute dBFS.
